lf-reel-1025am-crying-peak.alt_text: Illustrated Reel in soft dawn light: a pastel pink and blue sky over sage hills, a little cottage, and a sleepy smiling sun rising. Tiny baby clothes are pegged on a washing line, one more each beat. Text: You can't spoil a newborn. Pick them up. / Answer their cries, and they cry less. / Hungry? Diaper? Too hot or cold? / Hold close. Sway. Shush. Walk. / The sky turns to morning and the sun opens its eyes: Do this: Next cry: pick them up first. Source chips: CPS, AAP.

lf-reel-1025-step-away.alt_text: Illustrated Reel in soft afternoon light: pastel sky, sage hills, a little cottage and a resting sun with closed eyes. Tiny baby clothes sway on a washing line, one more each beat. Text: Still crying? At your limit? It's OK to step away. / Crib first. On their back. / Step out. Breathe. Take a moment. / Never shake a baby. Never. / The sky brightens and the sun opens its eyes: Do this: Tonight, pick who you'll text. “Can you come?” It's OK to ask for help. Source chip: CPS, Colic and crying.
